item.title: Trump says he will announce his Federal Reserve chair nominee on Friday morning
item.description: The long-awaited decision could set up a major showdown over the independence of the US central bank and its role in electoral politics.

item.title: Protest erupts in Utrecht after 'racist' Dutch police officer assaults two Muslim women
item.description: Demonstrators decry “systematic” racist violence as calls grow for suspension, apology, and accountability.

item.title: North Korea's Kim vows to 'transform' regions with major construction drive
item.description: The construction drive comes as the country remains under sanctions and struggles with economic and food challenges.

item.title: Burkina Faso's military government dissolves all political parties in sweeping power grab
item.description: Military rulers say that a ban is needed for unity and reform as elections remain indefinitely delayed.

item.title: Trump says he won't pull out ICE agents out of Minnesota despite backlash
item.description: US President rejected calls to scale back ICE operations in Minnesota, saying the administration will do “whatever we can” to keep the country safe.

item.description: US President Trump hopes a significant military buildup will bring Tehran to the negotiating table.

item.title: Gold prices fall sharply after rumours of Trump's new Fed pick
item.description: Silver and other precious metals followed gold lower after reaching historic peaks this month.

item.description: The ruling throws the future of two strategic terminals into doubt and sharpens US-China rivalry over the global shipping artery.

item.title: US lawmakers warn Nvidia chips are boosting China's military AI
